text:
sarah (AE): Kicking off ZeroTrustBank POC. They want SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, RBAC mapping to teams, and an option for on-prem/private deployment for healthcare data. Need feasibility + high-level pricing by EOD Wed. looping in @mike and @raj for tech details.

mike (SE): Quick Q — do they need IdP-initiated SAML only or OIDC flows too? Also: SCIM push from Okta or SCIM provisioner from our side? Any domain claim/verification requirements?

raj (Solutions Eng): They said Okta primary, Ping second. Initial ask is SAML SP-initiated + IdP-initiated for some apps. SCIM must sync users + groups; RBAC mapping should map Okta groups -> Redwood roles. They also asked about domain verification for assertion issuer binding (they want org-level domain proofing).

olivia (Security): Heads-up: on-prem/private will need KMS integration and audit log retention settings. If they require HSM-backed keys we need legal + infra lead time (typical 4–6 weeks for provisioning + attestation). Also need clarity on log retention timeframe (90 days vs 1 year changes pricing/compliance).

sarah (AE): Pricing question from buyer: if they commit ~10M tokens/mo and 500k SCIM ops/mo during onboarding, what's the uplift for Dedicated vs Private (one-time + monthly)? Also asked about SCIM rate scaling during initial import.

mike (SE): Ballpark: Dedicated baseline + 20% uplift for guaranteed qps, Private (VPC + support + license) is a larger step — rough ballpark initial attachment: setup fee + ~3–5x hosted unit cost depending on SLOs. I need committed qps to tighten numbers. For SCIM, our default tenant rate is 10 req/s; onboarding bursts should be handled via bulk import or temporary burst policy.

raj (Solutions Eng): Technical blocker to call out: their onboarding team's plan expects ~50 req/s sustained for 6 hours during cutover. Our current default rate will throttle that. Options:
- Temporary rate increase tied to contract
- Bulk CSV import endpoint for initial provisioning
- Pre-stage via dedicated ingestion pipeline (extra cost)

Also they want group -> role mapping with regex transforms. We support that in Console mapping rules (examples below).

mike (SE): Example mapping rule we recommend:

```
# map Okta group names like "team-frontend" -> role "team-frontend"
{"rule_type":"group_regex","pattern":"^team-(.*)$","role_template":"team-\1"}
```

And sample SCIM config snippet we share to explain rate/bulk behavior:

```
{
  "scim": {
    "rate_limit_per_tenant": 10,
    "burst_window_seconds": 60,
    "bulk_import_endpoint": "/scim/v2/Users/bulk"
  }
}
```

sarah (AE): Sales asks — can we promise a temporary burst to 50 req/s for a 6-hour window as part of onboarding if they sign a short-term addendum? If yes, estimate cost.

mike (SE): We can, but it requires a config change + monitoring + a safety cutoff. Ops needs notice 72h before window. Cost: estimate ~1.2x for that onboarding period (covers infra & ops support). I'll confirm exact number after I run capacity sim with expected payload sizes.

olivia (Security): Compliance item: they require per-assertion audit logs forwarded to their SIEM for 1 year and tenant-scoped access audit trails. That affects storage retention pricing. Add this to pricing ask.

raj (Solutions Eng): Action items I can own: draft a technical note that covers SAML flows we support, SCIM throughput options (burst vs bulk), RBAC mapping examples, and the domain verification flow. Will attach a small diagram + sample requests. Target: EOD tomorrow.

sarah (AE): Great. @mike — can you run the perf sim and send a 1-page estimate for Dedicated vs Private including onboarding burst cost? @olivia — can you send the minimal compliance checklist (KMS, SIEM, retention) so we can pass to procurement?

mike (SE): On it. I have a couple of assumptions to validate: average SCIM payload size (users w/ groups) and expected token size distribution for token estimate. DM me the sample payloads or ask ZeroTrustBank to send one.

olivia (Security): I'll pull the checklist and include required attestations for HSM + expected audit endpoints.

deploy-bot: build:private-package-redwood-private-v2.3.1.tar.gz uploaded to artifactory (sha256: abc123...). Note: current private package supports KMS integrations and SCIM bulk endpoint.

sarah (AE): Thanks everyone. I'll summarize for ZeroTrustBank and ask for the sample SCIM payload + target cutover window. :thumbsup:
